ai-data / Product analytics

PostHog

Understand product journeys and test improvements.

POfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Measure product events and investigate user journeys through PostHog's supported analytics, replay, experiment, and feature-flag capabilities. MoreSpace can build onboarding funnels, activation reports, and controlled rollout plans around an agreed event taxonomy. We connect observed behavior with a specific product hypothesis, validate instrumentation, and review privacy settings so the team learns from reliable signals instead of isolated event totals.

Useful outputs

  • Validated funnel and retention reports
  • Behavioral context for product issues
  • Controlled release and experiment readouts

Where we can apply it

  • Signup events → validated activation funnel → drop-off review → onboarding backlog.
  • Feature hypothesis → controlled flag rollout → experiment readout → product decision.
  • Support issue → permitted journey context → reproduction and fix → post-release monitoring.
01

Use case 1

Build signup-to-activation and trial-to-paid funnel views.

02

Use case 2

Investigate drop-off using permitted session replay context.

03

Use case 3

Roll out a feature and evaluate an agreed experiment hypothesis.

Inputs we need

  • An agreed event and identity schema
  • A product hypothesis and cohort window
  • Privacy and capture configuration

Delivery sequence

  • Instrument the necessary events and verify identities and counts.
  • Build the funnel or experiment around a clearly defined question.
  • Review results with cohort context and use flags for controlled rollout decisions.

Expert review points

  • Validate captured events and prevent sensitive-field or replay exposure.
  • Check sample quality and measurement windows before changing product strategy.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Custom web applications
  • Data warehouses
  • SDK integrations
  • Product decision workspaces

Signals we can make visible

  • Activation rate
  • Trial-to-paid rate
  • Retention rate
  • Funnel conversion rate

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
